title: Action from scan information
statement: Let $N$ be a nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean input alphabet. Given scan information $I$ and a Boolean choice $b$, the resulting machine action is the effective action of $N$ determined by the state and input-symbol data in $I$ together with $b$.
